subject: Medford Wrestling Program
overview: Hosts and local parents discuss the growth of wrestling in Medford, including the high school Greater Boston League co-op team and the establishment of a youth program. Guests outline recent grassroots efforts to secure equipment, recruit coaches, and fundraise for a regulation mat.

items.title: Introductions and Local Restaurants
items.summary: Guests Diane Noel and Marella Zaccaraccio introduce themselves and share their favorite local restaurants in Medford.

items.title: Overview of Wrestling
items.summary: The guests provide an overview of wrestling, describing it as an inclusive, mixed-gender sport that builds physical conditioning, mental discipline, and confidence across weight classes.

items.title: Greater Boston League Co-op Participation
items.summary: Noel and Zaccaraccio recount how their high school sons joined the Greater Boston League wrestling co-op, emphasizing the personal development, discipline, and leadership opportunities it provided.

items.title: Medford Youth Wrestling Initiative
items.summary: The guests describe partnering with Medford Recreation to launch a youth program, acquiring a donated wrestling mat from Excel Academy, and securing local coaching staff.

items.title: Fundraising and Upcoming Meets
items.summary: The discussion covers how families can register for recreation sessions, an ongoing fundraising drive with Friends of Medford Recreation for a regulation mat, and upcoming high school meets including sectionals.
